title: The staffing plan
summary: The seats as a plain staffing plan (Q1), typeset large: the founder's seat, then the six next seats, one per row, the name at 56px and what the seat owns beside it in the body voice. Each status is said once, as its group's key ('Filled', 'Not open yet'), and 'What the seat owns' once, as the column head. The page's one ruled list; no cards, bars, chips or codes.
